amendment_policy: Append dated entries to 'amendments' with a reason, before CNN predictions are opened. After a model is adjusted using these data they become development data and a new validation set is required.

amendments.change: MC execution moves from AMD Radeon RX 6600 to NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060; pmcxcl 0.7.5 via OpenCL is unchanged.
amendments.reason: Faster-hardware migration requested by the project owner.
amendments.effect_on_runs: All 3 N0 and all channel runs are produced on the RTX 3060. The partial AMD pilot (3 N0, 9 of 18 channel runs) is archived in results/validation_independent_archive_AMD_RX6600 and is used only for a cross-hardware consistency check.
amendments.unchanged: Design, conditions, seeds, photon tiers, quality plan, analysis plan, checkpoints and locked files.

design.lateral_shift_checks: Not part of this lock; any such check must be reported separately and adds no independent MC conditions.
design.predictions_note: Not independent samples: repeated MC of the same condition, and the same inputs scored by several models.

pilot.purpose: Check numerical quality before the full matrix; CNN predictions stay closed.

mc.seed_rule: N0: 30000000 + repeat*10000. Channel: 31000000 + tier*100000 + repeat*10000 + mua_index*100 + depth_index.
mc.runner: simulate.run(config, output, depth, mua, photons, seed) with configs/simulation.json unchanged

quality_plan.validity: Check seed, actual photons, initial energy, finite reflectance, positive N0, collection layer and geometry. Do not repair NaN or drop bad points to let the CNN run.
quality_plan.pairing: Channel repeat r is normalized only by N0 repeat r.

convergence.method: readout.compare(diagnostics(repeat 1), diagnostics(candidate)) for repeats 2 and 3; a condition passes when both pass
convergence.fwhm: must be defined and within the relative tolerance, including for weak signals

quality_plan.escalation: If a condition fails at tier t, run all three repeats of that condition at tier t+1 using the pre-assigned seeds. Keep every tier. Selection uses MC quality only and is fixed before CNN predictions are opened.
quality_plan.if_still_failing: Mark the condition as insufficiently reliable after tier 2; do not claim full validation of that region.
quality_plan.n0_escalation: N0 stays at 1.2e8 photons in this lock; changing it requires a dated amendment.
quality_plan.pilot_reuse: Pilot runs are the same manifest entries as the main matrix and are reused only if the configuration is unchanged and they pass.
quality_plan.forbidden_selection: Never drop a condition because the CNN is wrong, and never try extra seeds to keep favourable runs.

analysis_plan.model_input: readout.profile(channel, N0_same_repeat) as float32 batch x 1 x 128; identical input for F and K; channel absorption is never given to the network; model.eval() with torch.no_grad()
analysis_plan.aggregation: For each condition and model seed, compute the metric across the three MC repeats; then average conditions with equal weight. Report each model seed, the mean and the SD (ddof=1) across the three seeds.

primary_endpoint.name: delta_MAE_unseen
primary_endpoint.definition: MAE_K - MAE_F over the 20 conditions with mua in {0.22, 0.40}; positive means F has lower MAE

secondary_groups.seen_weak: mua in {0.15, 0.30}, each level and pooled; new MC, not a new absorption level for F
secondary_groups.standard_tradeoff: delta_standard = MAE_F - MAE_K at mua 0.508, with absolute values

analysis_plan.absorption_stability: At each depth and model seed, average predictions across the three MC repeats at each mua; R = max_over_mua - min_over_mua. Report R_F and R_K with MAE at that depth. Small R counts only if predictions are also close to the true depth.
analysis_plan.depth_discrimination: For each mua, report predicted-vs-true line, MAE, slope and intercept. R^2 alone is not used to conclude accuracy.

constant_baseline.definition: always predict the mean depth of the original training split

target.interpretation: Report the conditions meeting and missing MAE <= 0.5 mm. Project target; not a clinical standard or a per-prediction bound.

analysis_plan.paired_comparison: Absolute-error difference K - F on the same condition, MC repeat and model-seed pair.
analysis_plan.independence: 60 conditions are a fixed design grid. Three MC repeats measure numerical variation and three CNN seeds measure training variation; the three N0 maps are shared across conditions by repeat index. Do not multiply these into a physical sample size.
analysis_plan.statistical_inference: Descriptive paired effect sizes and consistency across seeds and conditions only; no population significance claim.
analysis_plan.conclusion_rules: Section 6 of Ke_hoach_tiep_theo_kiem_chung_doc_lap_FK.md. Completion does not depend on a result favourable to F.
